method.common_inputs: geometry and supplier input bytes reported separately and excluded symmetrically
excluded: legal compliance or satellite ground-truth accuracy
method.hot: one isolated child per representation; load full AOI once then warmups and measured batches
method.load: includes validation and integrity hashing performed by each native loader
method.os_file_cache: uncontrolled and likely warm after verification/encoding; NOT disk-cold
method.p95_method: nearest rank; with 7 repetitions p95 equals maximum
method.process_cold: fresh Python child per repetition; timed full load+query after imports and geometry read
method.resources: separate child lifetime peak RSS; not incremental operation-only memory
method.storage: only files required by actual loaders; original TIFFs plus acquisition provenance; generated duplicate metadata counted separately as research overhead
method.subprocess_wall: includes startup/imports/common geometry read/JSON output and exit

retained_selection.reason: Retain separate_zstd_l19 at chunk1024 as minimum necessary stored bytes among fully exact levels3/9/19 at256/512/1024. Complete store535012 bytes versus actual source loader585293 bytes (576999 TIFF +8294 acquisition provenance), saving50281 bytes /8.59%. Unused948-byte generated source metadata is research overhead only and excluded from all denominators. Every raw value/mask/metadata and17/17 real query results match, as do all timed digests. Encoding costs212.443 ms wall; cold-process median5.800 ms. This selects minimum storage with bounded one-time ingestion cost; hot speedup and disk-cold access are not claimed. Prior archives/decisions remain unchanged.

winner.criterion: minimum total stored bytes among fully exact candidates

limitations: Mapped tree-cover loss is not legal deforestation or a compliance verdict.
Treecover2000 describes year-2000 canopy context, not a 2020 forest baseline.
The latest Hansen release may differ from the supplier historical analysis vintage.
Supplier declarations and opaque evidence references are unverified; referenced evidence is unavailable.
Cell counts use native centers covered by each polygon; they are not hectares or complete polygon area.
Exact source/compact agreement measures encoding fidelity, not satellite or legal accuracy.
The 17 supplied plots are a small local cohort, not a representative global evaluation.
JRC 2020 baseline and restriction/legality layers are unavailable in this export.
Company sample publication rights are unresolved; keep this generated demo local.
